info.name: express-typescript-graphql-boilerplate-server
info.description:
GraphQL API for **express-typescript-graphql-boilerplate-server**.

Every operation is a `POST {{baseUrl}}/graphql` with a GraphQL body. In Postman's **Body > GraphQL** tab you can click *Auto-fetch* to load the schema for autocomplete (introspection is enabled outside production).

**Setup**
1. Start the server: `npm run dev`
2. Set `baseUrl` in the collection's **Variables** tab if you don't use port 3001.
3. Run the whole collection (Run collection) or send requests one by one, top to bottom.

**Errors** come back as HTTP 200 with an `errors` array. Check `errors[0].extensions.code` (e.g. `VALIDATION_ERROR`, `NOT_FOUND`, `EMAIL_TAKEN`) and `extensions.status` (the HTTP-equivalent status). Every request has tests that check the expected result.

**Seed first:** `npm run seed` creates the roles (super-admin, support, user) and one account for each. The Users, Example, Roles and Admin folders log in as them.

**Auth:** protected requests use `Authorization: Bearer {{token}}`; **register**, **login** and **changePassword** save `token` automatically.

**Variables** set by scripts: `registerEmail` (fresh per run), `token`, `previousToken`, `userId`, `exampleId`, and `registerPassword`/`newPassword` (swapped after a password change).

request.description: Plain HTTP liveness probe for Docker / load balancers. Not part of the GraphQL API.

item.name: Auth
item.description:
Register, login, `me`, change password and logout.

Run top to bottom: requests save `token` (and `previousToken`) for the ones after them. Protected requests send `Authorization: Bearer {{token}}` (see each request's **Authorization** tab).

**Rate limit:** register, login and changePassword share one per-IP limiter where only **failed** attempts count, up to `AUTH_RATE_LIMIT_MAX` per 15 minutes. This folder makes 4 deliberate failures per run, so with the `.env.example` value of 5 a second run within 15 minutes gets `TOO_MANY_REQUESTS`. For local testing set `AUTH_RATE_LIMIT_MAX=50` in `.env`, or restart the dev server to reset the counter.

item.description: CRUD for the template `Example` module. Reads are public; mutations need user permissions. New accounts get `createExample` and `updateExample`, but `deleteExample` must be granted. Run in order: **createExample** stores the new id in `exampleId`.

item.name: Roles
item.description: Role-based access control. Each user has one role (a named set of permissions) plus optional per-user `extraPerms`. System roles `super-admin` (locked) and `user` (default) always exist. Needs the seeded accounts: run `npm run seed` first. Run after the Auth, Users and Example folders.
